name: bathtub-bets
description: Phish setlist prediction tool — rotation analysis, venue history, and a PHISH bingo game

scripts._comment_backtest: Dev tool: re-predicts every past show with lib/model.mjs and grades it against baselines. Needs the gitignored raw setlists, so it does not run in CI. Its output is not the public track record.
scripts.build: node scripts/build-songmeta.js && node scripts/build-history.js && node scripts/build-public.js
scripts.deploy: npm test && npm run build && wrangler deploy
scripts._comment_deploy_ci: CI build: history.json is rebuilt from the committed archive, then public/ is assembled from committed artifacts. Skips build:songmeta, which needs the 14MB of gitignored raw setlists.
scripts._comment_fetch_showtimes: fetch-showtimes runs after fetch because it reads the schedule fetch.js refreshes. It degrades to a retained or fallback time rather than throwing, so it will not fail the chain on a bad response from phish.com.
